museSub: A story of confidence, freedom, and rediscovery.
museLede: A real story, real moments, and portraits that celebrate who she is and who she’s becoming.
filmCopy: Movement, laughter, quiet moments. A deeper look into Kaylee’s experience with The Glam Muse Experience.
deservePara1: This experience is about more than beautiful portraits. It’s about giving yourself permission to be seen, to feel confident, and to celebrate you — exactly as you are right now.
deservePara2: My hope is that my story inspires you to take this step for yourself, because every woman deserves to feel beautiful, confident, and empowered.
landingCtaTitle: It’s time to tell your story.
landingCtaCopy: You deserve to see yourself differently — and this is where it begins.
